results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  col_quebec,
  col_delta
FROM tbl_zulu
WHERE col_delta = 'L12'
ORDER BY col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT tbl_zulu.col_quebec
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_juliet ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_juliet.col_papa = 'Ni'
ORDER BY tbl_zulu.col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT col_quebec, col_falcon
FROM tbl_zulu
WHERE col_falcon < 4
ORDER BY col_falcon ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_delta.col_iris
FROM tbl_delta
JOIN tbl_zulu ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_delta.col_iris IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_iris DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS convex_hull_compound_count
FROM tbl_delta
WHERE col_hotel IS TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_delta.col_luna, tbl_delta.col_hotel, tbl_delta.col_xenon
FROM tbl_delta
JOIN tbl_zulu ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_delta.col_luna < -0.5
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_xenon ASC, tbl_delta.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  col_papa AS element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT col_rhea) AS entry_count
FROM tbl_juliet
GROUP BY col_papa
ORDER BY entry_count DESC, element
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    tbl_zulu.col_quebec,
    tbl_delta.col_luna
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_juliet ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_juliet.col_papa = 'Al'
  AND tbl_delta.col_hotel = TRUE
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  tbl_zulu.col_halo AS crystal_system,
  AVG(tbl_delta.col_luna) AS avg_eform
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
GROUP BY tbl_zulu.col_halo
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM tbl_delta
WHERE col_hotel = false
  AND col_xenon < 0.05
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT z.col_quebec
FROM tbl_zulu AS z
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tbl_juliet AS j_ni
    WHERE j_ni.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
      AND j_ni.col_papa = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tbl_juliet AS j_al
    WHERE j_al.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
      AND j_al.col_papa = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY z.col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_juliet.col_papa, tbl_delta.col_luna
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_juliet ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_juliet.col_zulu = 'A-site'
  AND tbl_juliet.col_papa = 'Co'
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT z.col_quebec, z.col_apollo, d.col_iris
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE z.col_apollo = 221
  AND d.col_iris > 0
ORDER BY d.col_iris DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  tbl_victor.col_papa,
  tbl_victor.col_uniform,
  tbl_victor.col_gemini
FROM tbl_victor
ORDER BY tbl_victor.col_uniform DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  tbl_juliet.col_papa,
  AVG(tbl_delta.col_xenon) AS avg_convex_hull_distance
FROM tbl_juliet
JOIN tbl_zulu
  ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_delta
  ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_juliet.col_juliet = 0.75
GROUP BY tbl_juliet.col_papa
ORDER BY avg_convex_hull_distance ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  z.col_quebec,
  d.col_luna,
  ((jc.col_juliet * vc.col_tango + jt.col_juliet * vt.col_tango) / (jc.col_juliet + jt.col_juliet)) AS weighted_ref_energy,
  d.col_luna - ((jc.col_juliet * vc.col_tango + jt.col_juliet * vt.col_tango) / (jc.col_juliet + jt.col_juliet)) AS calculated_formation_enthalpy
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_juliet jc ON jc.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_xray xc ON jc.col_papa = xc.col_papa
JOIN tbl_victor vc ON vc.col_papa = xc.col_papa
JOIN tbl_juliet jt ON jt.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_xray xt ON jt.col_papa = xt.col_papa
JOIN tbl_victor vt ON vt.col_papa = xt.col_papa
WHERE z.col_quebec = 'Co3Ti'
  AND jc.col_papa = 'Co'
  AND jt.col_papa = 'Ti'
ORDER BY z.col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT z.col_quebec, d.col_luna
FROM tbl_delta d
JOIN tbl_zulu z ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE d.col_hotel = true
  AND z.col_delta = 'L12'
  AND d.col_luna < -0.3
ORDER BY d.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  tbl_juliet.col_papa AS a_site,
  AVG(tbl_delta.col_luna) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_juliet ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_zulu.col_delta = 'L12'
  AND tbl_delta.col_hotel = TRUE
  AND tbl_juliet.col_zulu = 'a'
GROUP BY tbl_juliet.col_papa
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
